title: Sable and the Thorn
premise: Ada Okafor has spent her life guarding the Sable Gate in the Thornfell mountains, keeping the smugglers' roads quiet and the old covenant between the human realm and the dragon-held Emberlands intact. When a century-old prophecy book surfaces naming tonight's date as the night the gate fails, Ada discovers the covenant was never a treaty but a leash — and that her own family forged it through betrayal. Hunted by the Crown's inquisitors, courted by the last dragon, and shadowed by the smuggler who knows her secrets, she must decide whether to reforge the covenant as it was or break it entirely. In the end, Ada rewrites the covenant with her own blood and truth-telling, freeing both realms at the cost of the gate — and her place behind it.
about_author: Marguerite Yarrow is the pen name of a former mountain-rescue dispatcher who grew up on border-town folklore and now writes fantasy about people who keep doors shut for a living. She lives somewhere high, cold, and deliberately off the map.

chapters.title: The Keeper's Ledger
chapters.summary: Ada Okafor audits the Sable Gate's nightly traffic of smugglers and pilgrims, establishing her meticulous control over Thornfell. POV: Ada. Beat: quiet competence masking loneliness.

chapters.title: A Date Written in Ash
chapters.summary: A dying peddler trades Ada a scorched prophecy book; tonight's date is circled in century-old ink beside her own name. POV: Ada. Beat: dread cracking routine open.

chapters.title: The Smuggler Who Knew
chapters.summary: Ryn Vasq, a smuggler Ada has tolerated for years, reveals he's been carrying prophecy pages across the pass for months. POV: Ryn. Beat: uneasy alliance born of mutual blackmail.

chapters.title: What the Gate Remembers
chapters.summary: The gate flares without cause; Ada hears a voice counting down in Old Emberish. POV: Ada. Beat: first supernatural rupture, wonder laced with fear.

chapters.title: Inquisitors at the Inn
chapters.summary: Crown inquisitor Halvard Brann arrives hunting heretical texts, forcing Ada to hide the book inside the gatehouse. POV: Halvard. Beat: cat-and-mouse tension, his sincerity unsettling.

chapters.title: The Last Dragon's Summons
chapters.summary: A dream pulls Ada into the Emberlands where the dying dragon Vessarath names her 'daughter of the forger.' POV: Ada. Beat: revelation that her bloodline built the covenant.

chapters.title: Blood Price
chapters.summary: Ada learns the covenant runs on Okafor blood, renewed each generation by a keeper's sacrifice. POV: Ada. Beat: horror at inherited complicity.

chapters.title: The Road Through Thornfell
chapters.summary: Ada and Ryn flee the gatehouse ahead of Brann's warrant, navigating smuggler roads she alone knows. POV: Ryn. Beat: grudging trust forming under pursuit.

chapters.title: The Hollow Shrine
chapters.summary: They shelter in a shrine to the covenant's first signatories and find Ada's ancestor's confession carved in stone. POV: Ada. Beat: grief curdling into anger.

chapters.title: Brann's Bargain
chapters.summary: Halvard corners them, offering clemency if Ada surrenders the book and lets the Crown 'manage' the gate. POV: Halvard. Beat: temptation of safety over truth.

chapters.title: Emberfall Village
chapters.summary: In a border village starving since dragon-fire dwindled, Ada sees what the failing covenant costs mortals too. POV: Ryn. Beat: compassion complicating her mission.

chapters.title: The Second Prophecy
chapters.summary: A hidden page shows two endings: reforging the covenant, or breaking it — one saves dragons, one saves humans, not both. POV: Ada. Beat: despair at a rigged choice.

chapters.title: Wolves of the Crown
chapters.summary: Brann's soldiers burn the shrine trail; Ryn takes a crossbow bolt covering Ada's escape. POV: Ryn. Beat: loyalty proven at real cost.

chapters.title: Vessarath's Wound
chapters.summary: Ada reaches the dragon's lair and sees the wound in his chest shaped exactly like the Sable Gate's keystone. POV: Ada. Beat: sickening understanding of the covenant's mechanism.

chapters.title: The Forger's Daughter
chapters.summary: Vessarath recounts the betrayal: Ada's ancestor bound dragon-fire to human survival, stealing choice from both realms. POV: Vessarath (dream-voice). Beat: mythic weight, moral vertigo.

chapters.title: What Ryn Carried
chapters.summary: Recovering, Ryn admits he was paid by an Emberlands faction wanting the gate broken — he chose Ada over coin. POV: Ryn. Beat: betrayal confessed, forgiveness tentatively offered.

chapters.title: The Guttering Flame
chapters.summary: Dragon-fire visibly dims across the peaks; frost creeps into the Emberlands' green valleys. POV: Ada. Beat: ticking clock made visceral.

chapters.title: Halvard's Doubt
chapters.summary: Halvard finds the ancestor's confession and begins questioning the Crown's official history of the covenant. POV: Halvard. Beat: a hunter turning reluctant witness.

chapters.title: The Council of Ash
chapters.summary: Ada petitions the Emberlands' remnant council for aid; they demand the gate destroyed outright. POV: Ada. Beat: pressure from allies more extreme than enemies.

chapters.title: Smuggler's Justice
chapters.summary: Ryn's old crew, fearing lost trade, sell their route to Brann. POV: Ryn. Beat: bitter lesson that everyone serves something.

chapters.title: Keystone and Blood
chapters.summary: Studying the keystone, Ada realizes a willing Okafor sacrifice could reforge the covenant — her death, freely given. POV: Ada. Beat: the price named plainly.

chapters.title: Refusal
chapters.summary: Ryn refuses to let her die and proposes breaking the gate instead, damning the Emberlands to save her. POV: Ryn. Beat: love versus duty, sharply drawn.

chapters.title: The Third Path
chapters.summary: Re-reading the prophecy, Ada finds a third ending hinted in marginalia: a covenant rewritten, not renewed or broken. POV: Ada. Beat: hope with a razor's edge.

chapters.title: March of the Inquisition
chapters.summary: Brann, ordered to seize the gate for the Crown, marches on Thornfell with an army. POV: Halvard. Beat: dread of institutional power.

chapters.title: The Burning Pass
chapters.summary: Ada collapses a smuggler road to slow the army, destroying the livelihoods she once protected. POV: Ada. Beat: survival demanding she betray her own stewardship.

chapters.title: Prisoner of the Gate
chapters.summary: Captured, Ada is brought before Brann, who quietly returns her book — he wants her to prove the truth. POV: Halvard. Beat: enemy becoming accomplice.

chapters.title: The General's Ambition
chapters.summary: Brann's superior, General Corvane, arrives intending to harness dragon-fire as a weapon. POV: Corvane. Beat: power's corruption embodied.

chapters.title: Night Assault on the Sable Gate
chapters.summary: Corvane's forces breach the gatehouse; the keystone cracks and dragon-fire screams through the pass. POV: Ryn. Beat: chaos, sacrifice, the prophecy date arriving.

chapters.title: The Gate Fails
chapters.summary: As foretold, the gate shatters; realms bleed together and the Emberlands begin to freeze and burn at once. POV: Ada. Beat: apocalypse fulfilling the page.

chapters.title: Stand at the Threshold
chapters.summary: Ada, Ryn, and a defected Brann hold the threshold against Corvane's men while Vessarath crawls toward the ruin. POV: Ryn. Beat: desperate unity against overwhelming force.

chapters.title: Corvane's Ascension
chapters.summary: Corvane drinks raw dragon-fire to claim its power and begins to burn from within, monstrous and radiant. POV: Corvane. Beat: theme made flesh — power consuming its seeker.

chapters.title: The Confession
chapters.summary: Before the armies of both realms, Ada publicly reads her ancestor's confession, shattering the covenant's moral authority. POV: Ada. Beat: truth as weapon and liberation.

chapters.title: Fire Against Fire
chapters.summary: Vessarath battles the fire-drunk Corvane above the broken gate while Ada races to the keystone. POV: Ada. Beat: climax ignites.

chapters.title: Rewriting the Covenant
chapters.summary: At the shattered keystone, Ada cuts her palm and writes new terms: no blood-price, no leash, free passage and mutual keeping. POV: Ada. Beat: agency seizing destiny.

chapters.title: The Cost of Truth
chapters.summary: The new covenant demands a witness bound to both realms; the magic takes Ada's connection to Thornfell itself. POV: Ada. Beat: victory priced in belonging.

chapters.title: Fall of Corvane
chapters.summary: Unmade by the rewritten covenant's terms, Corvane burns out; Vessarath lands, wounded but alive, fire steadied. POV: Halvard. Beat: catharsis after terror.

chapters.title: Two Realms, One Road
chapters.summary: Humans and Emberfolk meet on the open pass, wary, negotiating; Ryn becomes the first sanctioned bridge-trader. POV: Ryn. Beat: fragile new order taking root.

chapters.title: The Empty Gatehouse
chapters.summary: Ada visits the ruined gatehouse where she spent her life and finds she can no longer hear the gate at all. POV: Ada. Beat: mourning the self she was.

chapters.title: Keeper No Longer
chapters.summary: Ada declines a ceremonial title, choosing instead to walk the border as witness, with Ryn and Brann's reformed company. POV: Ada. Beat: identity rebuilt beyond duty.

chapters.title: First Light on Thornfell
chapters.summary: Dawn over an open pass; dragon-fire glows steady on the peaks as Ada writes the true history in a new ledger. POV: Ada. Beat: bittersweet peace, story complete.
